It makes us less safe, physically and mentally, and that is the intention. The movement that Patrisse helped foster has brought real scrutiny to how police treat Black people in the U.S., and there is deeply vested interests in stopping it. 

#patrissecullors #BLM

We see our sister #patrissecullors as someone who takes accountability for her mistakes, and thus we believe her when she says these things are untrue. We support Black women, we support the movement, and we will keep organizing for accountability because #BlackLivesMatter

There absolutely must be accountability for this, and we call upon the Oklahoma Police Department to exercise full transparency in footage, disciplinary records and all information related to this incident.

#quadrysanders #policebrutality #policeaccountability #blacklivesmatter
